changeability.rationale: Most fixes (sprites, cards, formatting) land in one helper or component, but a few small rules (effect-text fallback, type-label mapping) are duplicated across route loaders and must be fixed in two or three places.

app/src/components/type-badge.tsx:8-11 — mild link/large boolean-flag creep, acceptable at this size
coupling.rationale: Loose coupling with clean seams: typed component props, serializable loader data, server/client split is explicit. The one tangle is the home page reading sibling form controls off the DOM.

evidence: app/src/lib/api.ts:98-113 — cardsForPokemon with an extra() callback absorbs the ability page's hidden flag without a boolean parameter
app/src/components/section.tsx:9-14 — Section generalizes the spec's named-region pattern, reused by five sections
app/src/routes/moves/[name]/index.tsx:51-71 — facts dl and 404/head boilerplate are inlined per route rather than shared

abstraction_design.rationale: Abstractions are built around the app's real variation (extra-callback for cards, prop-driven table) rather than flags, so an Items page would reuse Section/api/format helpers — but the per-route loader, facts dl and 404 boilerplate would be copied from Moves rather than shared.

findings.issue: go() reads the Type/Generation selects by scraping searchRef.value?.form and namedItem('type')/'generation' from the DOM instead of tracking their values in signals
findings.suggestion: Give each select a useSignal bound via value/onChange (as the search input already does) and build Filters from signals; also rename-proof against future form restructuring

findings.issue: Effect-text fallback (short_effect, else latest flavor text, else em dash) is duplicated in the ability loader (app/src/routes/abilities/[name]/index.tsx:15-16)
findings.suggestion: Extract a shared shortEffectOrFlavor(resource) helper into lib/format.ts so an Items page and future tweaks have one home

findings.issue: Home-page loader assembles CardData inline, duplicating sprite/type-label assembly from cardsForPokemon (app/src/lib/api.ts:109)
findings.suggestion: Have speciesIndex or a small cardFromIndexEntry() helper in lib/api.ts build the cards so card-assembly rules live in one module

findings.issue: The labels.get(name) ?? humanize(name) type-label mapping is repeated in three loaders (also pokemon :90, moves :21, types :26)
findings.suggestion: Add typeLabel(labels, name) (or have typeLabels() return richer objects) in lib/api.ts

findings.issue: The '<count> Pokémon' + PokemonCards block is copy-pasted across the type, ability and move pages
findings.suggestion: Promote a small PokemonListSection component (count + list) in components/; it would also be the natural place to add list-level sorting

findings.issue: link and large boolean props are mild flag creep
findings.suggestion: Fine at current size; if a third variant appears, switch to a variant prop or split Link variants

findings.issue: .card__note (the 'Hidden ability' note) would become dead CSS if the Abilities feature is removed, since nothing else uses it
findings.suggestion: Acceptable now; if the feature is ever dropped, delete the rule alongside the route

summary: A well-factored, idiomatic Qwik City app: one server-only data module with all env/caching concerns, narrow typed component props, and one route file per page, so most changes land in an obvious single place. The main costs of change are small duplications — effect-text fallback, type-label mapping, and card assembly — spread across route loaders. Extending with an Items section works but means copying the Moves route's boilerplate rather than reusing it.
